items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Louis Armstrong, good enough for me, I'd just buy it.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, of course. Of course. I remember those records. They used to cost 75 cents. And I used to buy them. I used to buy a record -- I used to go in a store and ask the man, "Do you have any Louis Armstrong records?" And he'd say yeah, and I'd just buy it. I wouldn't even listen to it. Louis Armstrong, good enough for me, I'd just buy it. Fletcher Henderson records, yeah. And everybody -- I wouldn't say anybody, but most people's houses, you know, you went to, had Fletcher Henderson's records. They could say…
